generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: The Lucid key to the flowering plant families, with Reed College's family page, as search results quote them (the pages themselves were not read): corolla sympetalous, usually 4- or 5-lobed, often two-lipped (regular in Plantago); stamens 4 (didynamous) or 2, on the corolla tube; ovary superior, of 2 carpels, one style.

traits.stipules.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 324 Scrophulariaceae (in part: foxgloves, speedwells, snapdragons, beardtongues) and 297 Plantaginaceae (plantains), which APG joins as Plantaginaceae: herbs or shrubs; leaves alternate, opposite or whorled; stipules absent; fruit a capsule, in the plantains opening by a lid.
